name: chargegrid
description: ChargeGrid Intelligence — API, dashboard comercial e app do motorista (FIAP × GoodWe, EV Challenge 2026)

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @chargegrid/sdk && npm run typecheck -w @chargegrid/mobile
scripts.gen:openapi: docker compose --env-file apps/api/.env run --rm --no-deps -v "./apps/api:/app" api python -m scripts.exportar_openapi
scripts.gen:contrato: npm run gen:openapi && npm run gen:types
scripts.forecast: npm run forecast:train && npm run forecast:export
scripts.forecast:train: docker compose --env-file apps/api/.env --profile forecast run --rm --build forecast python treinar.py
scripts.forecast:export: docker compose --env-file apps/api/.env --profile forecast run --rm forecast python exportar.py
scripts.forecast:test: docker compose --env-file apps/api/.env --profile forecast run --rm --build forecast python -m pytest tests -q
scripts.forecast:lint: docker compose --env-file apps/api/.env --profile forecast run --rm --build --no-deps forecast sh -c "ruff check . && ruff format --check ."
